reviews.text: We came, we climbed with excitement buttttttt....... Lets dive in! The altitude of this place is more than 4thousand meters above sea level. You can check out our images and note that its quite challenging to be up here. In fact, while we were taking the cable car up, some of us started to use the oxygen tanks. And our bodies were not able to acclimate fast enough thus causing some of our accompanying affiliates to vomit our a couple of times. Some even stayed indoors due to feeling faint. We did manage to enjoy abit but wasnt able to accept the challenge to climb to the peak as our bodies just couldnt follow through. For those seeking to go. Jiayou! Bragging rights for you to reach the top! All in all, we would highly to recommend to here. But if your body says otherwise, it would be best to follow and not push yourself too far. Ps: we are adding our QR as a smoother process to see and view places we have been to. Cheers!!

Standing at the observation deck of Yulong Snow Mountain, you realize photos don’t do justice to God’s amazing creation. I visited this place with my family and a tour group during the winter season. The jagged, snow-dusted peaks against the deep blue sky are simply breathtaking. One of the most unforgettable moments was reaching the higher altitudes and seeing the seas of clouds break across the ridges—it felt like looking out from the windows of heaven. Praise God! ​What really stood out to me, though, was how accessible the experience was. The mountain cable car is well-engineered, whisking you up to the observation deck smoothly while offering a bird's-eye view of the changing landscape. The entire park infrastructure—from the shuttle buses to the well-maintained boardwalks—is clearly well thought out. It takes the stress out of the high-altitude environment, allowing you to actually focus on the scenery. ​It’s a rare place where raw, wild beauty meets top-tier facilities. An absolute highlight of my time in Lijiang.

We took a tour from Dali that left around 5.40am. Most tours gather at a main terminal where you can buy hats, gloves, food, water, O2 canisters and there are coffee shops and toilets. From here, you take buses to the lake or either cable car (expect to queue for these) and your ticket has a set time for each cable car. The lake visit was good (additional cost for the buggy ride) and had some decent views. The smaller cable car route to the meadow was also enjoyable and the scenery at the top was impressive. For the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, you take a bus from the main terminal to the cable car and queue for a while. The ride is long and the views are excellent. At the top, you can enjoy the scenery and walk up further, the altitude can be a challenge so take your time. Lots of people were struggling so the O2 canisters are worth bringing. However, you should buy these in Dali and avoid the tour scams that force you to buy their 'special, government approved' packs for far more money. Be prepared for a long queue for the return cable car journey.

Yulong Snow Mountain, also known as Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, is a striking natural landmark near Lijiang. I visited as part of a day trip and found the experience memorable, though there are a few things worth keeping in mind. The mountain is impressive from a distance, especially on a clear day when the snow-covered peaks are visible above the clouds. Getting up to the Glacier Park (around 4,500 meters) requires taking a cable car. The ride itself is smooth, and the views become increasingly dramatic as you ascend. However, the altitude is no joke — several people around me, including myself, felt lightheaded or short of breath even after just a few steps. Bringing an oxygen canister is highly recommended, especially if you’re not used to high elevations. At the top, the snow and scenery are beautiful but expect large crowds and limited time, as staff often move people along quickly. Paths are mostly wooden walkways with railings, but they can get slippery. Dress warmly, even in summer — temperatures were close to freezing when I visited in June. Back at the lower elevations, Blue Moon Valley was a nice surprise. The turquoise-colored water is unusually vivid and makes for a peaceful walk, although parts of the area feel a bit curated for tourists. The site overall is well-maintained, but also heavily commercialized. Long queues, ticket checks, and photo stations are part of the experience. Still, if you’re in the Lijiang area and interested in high-altitude landscapes, it’s worth considering. Just be prepared: the beauty of the place is real, but so is the altitude and the tourism infrastructure built around it.
Very photogenic scenery spot. Tremendous view on top of the mountain. Worht to visit once in a lifetime! Highly recommended.
Its a good experience going up 4506m though I felt the side effects of high altitude. The view is magnificent and the other scenic spots below surrounding the mountain is also very scenic.

This is one of the highest peaks I went and I had no regrets going up even though you need to really prepare yourself with oxygen canisters for the air is thin up there. If possible, try to be up there to catch the first light of the day. That means you may need to get up there by 7.30am! The views are breathtaking! However, you have to take the steps slowly and rest, breathe the oxygen as you go along. But we made it eventually. No regrets! Must visit 玉龙雪山Jade Dragon Snow Mountain when you go Yunnan.
Superb! Love the mountain. Went w elderly and went to the 3280m summit instead of 4680m. Thankful for some snow 1-2 weeks ago hence it has some snow cap on it. Many food stops along the way.

The Glacier Park cable car is a thrilling experience, whisking you rapidly up to over 4,500 meters for truly epic, close-up views of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain glaciers. The air is thin, but the views of the snowfields and surrounding peaks are absolutely magnificent. Unfortunately many staff lack of english especially tourist center so it can be confusing, we always talk to them by google translate🤣

Jade Dragon Snow Mountain stands over 4,000 meters above sea level. To reach the summit, you need to take a local bus for about 30 minutes, followed by a 20-minute cable car ride. Due to the high altitude, it’s advisable to carry oxygen tanks to manage symptoms of altitude sickness such as dizziness, headaches, and palpitations. If you are elderly or have heart or lung conditions, it’s best not to stay at the top for too long. There are wooden pathways at the summit. Fortunately, the weather was sunny during our visit, with only small patches of ice. If the weather is sunny, there's no need to rent a thermal coat. Also, avoid buying herbal medicines, as many are unnecessary, often targeting tourists.

Unfortunately, when I visited it was rainy and cloudy, but I was still lucky to visit the highest peak that the cable car could reach and from there I could climb to the highest peak allowed, luckily the weather was better then. But note that it is necessary to prepare an oxygen tank so as not to be affected by altitude shock

Once in the lifetime experience right here. It was on Thursday 18th of December, we got to see the mountain full of snow in a sunny day even though the day before was full of rocks and cloudy. Feel like the universe is on your side.

31 Oct 2025 云南 Day6. Jade dragon snow mountain 玉龙雪山 When we arrived, it was raining & foggy. A little disappointed with the weather. Nevertheless it was a fun experience using the oxygen & moving like a tortoise taking a step at a time to counter attitude sickness. Glad we made it.
The primeval forest is very beautiful, with a vision from the grass and high mountains. Areas with green moss and very mysterious. The schedule can take 1 day and should prepare a cold jacket.

Unfortunately the weather wasn’t great today. Been drizzling here and there which makes it cold & abit miserable. The walk up was abit tedious too.. maybe cause am old. The oxygen tank does help abit on the way up but doesn’t really stop my heart racing lol. Wished the weather was better n less foggy.
Lijiang’s crown jewel — Jade Dragon Snow Mountain! ❄️ Absolutely a must-visit when you’re here. The view, the air, the feeling… unforgettable! 🌿⛰️
Need oxygen bottles to reach the top where is allowed to by walks, after the cable car landing. Extremely breathtaking only for 200meters more.

Only managed to catch glimpses of the mountain due to uncooperative weather. Nonetheless, what we did manage to see was spectacular. There are number of things to see and do here. Advice is to plan for a full day. According to our guide the best time to visit is spring - flowers in bloom and lots of snow visible on the mountain. Would like to plan a return visit.

Yulong Snow Mountain 玉龙雪山 sits outside Lijiang like a frosty bouncer, eternally towering at nearly 5600 meters, daring tourists to come up for air and then stealing it immediately. It’s called Jade Dragon Snow Mountain because apparently “White Freezer of Doom” didn’t test well with the marketing team. Most people reach it by cable car, which is less of a ride and more of a slow ascent into oxygen debt. By the time you reach the viewing platforms, you’ll be clutching your rented oxygen can like it’s vintage champagne, while the locals in light jackets stroll past wondering why foreigners always look like they’re reenacting their final moments. The mountain is sacred to the Naxi people, but to most visitors it’s sacred mostly because it has bathrooms at altitude. If the thin air doesn’t humble you, the ticket prices will, proof that avalanches aren’t the only thing that can hit hard here. Yes, it’s breathtaking. But so is choking.

The weather can be hit or miss. If it's too windy they will cancel all the cable cars. Take frequent breaks when walking up and use the supplemental oxygen and you will be fine. The views at the top are otherworldly and worth making the trip.

Breathtakingly beautiful, at the altitude of 4506m, it's also suggested to carry a bottle of portable oxygen all the time. And it's super cold and it's snowing.. No words can describe how amazing and sacred this mountain is. It's a must visit but make sure you use a good guide.

A nice place to visit. You can do it by yourself. Just take bus from the bus station 7:30am first bus 101 price 15¥… park ticket entrance 100¥ (bring your passport) and to do the lake. It’s 20¥ extra for transportation. Then you have to pay extra for the cable cars and all the attractions around the park.

It's an amazing place to be. The view is amazing, and breathtaking. The way up the mountain takes some time. You will need to take buses, walk, bus and cable car and a view waiting lines. I believe we had a less busy day, and o can't imagine how crazy it must be if you go during the weekend or on a public holiday. So plan wisely and go early to avoid peak hours. Keep in mind that you also need to go down, which might take a while. Do you need oxygen? It depends, if you are fit and healthy, you won't need it (most likely). If you are already concerned, take it. But buy in the city, not during the tour.

Beautiful snow mountain covered in snow all year round, with cable car to transport visitors to 3k+ metres above sea level. Even with thick and windproof clothing it's freezing cold, especially when the wind comes. Bring some portable oxygen canisters and walk slowly to keep well. There's toilets available on the mountains.

Tallest mountain in Lijiang city, located several miles from the ancient town. Entrance fee are required and advised to buy early. Strong wind up there and the cable cars are fast. Temperature are really low up there suggest to wear thicker. Air is very thin and gets dizzy easily, be sure you have your oxygen ready and fit before hiking up there. Overall a great experience for overseas traveller.

Even though the day we visited was wet and misty, we still had a very unique experience. The opportunity to be up in the mountains surrounded by the fresh mist was something not many can said they have experienced. The forests looked completely different in this condition than they would on a sunny day, and offered a completely different experience overall. Do plan your time properly as it can get extremely busy at certain hours of the day!

Overall, it is well-maintained. There is cable car to bring you all the way up to 4506 altitude. The highest will be at 4680 altitude, and there is staircase for you to go up all the way. Breathtaking view especially if you manage to catch the sunrise on the mountain. Suggest to come over during the morning, as the wind is not strong at this timing. There is also jacket to be rent before you go up and oxygen bottles for you to purchase and bring along due to the thinning air. We spent about half day here including lunch.

Amazing snowy mountain scenery. One of the few amazing vistas to be seen in Yunnan and surrounding areas. Take the cable car up and take a spray can of oxygen with you just in case (can be purchased prior to going up). This scenery can’t be missed if you are in Yunnan province

Very beautiful place to visit. Strongly suggest to hike. It is so beautiful you can see the milk river, snow, snow mountain and some very unique wild flowers live in high altitude. Make sure bring lots of water and wear sun block.

The Jade Dragon Snow Mountains is an impressive sight. Rising 4,506 m above sea level, one needs to take a cable car to reach the peak. Sometimes, the queue to take the cable car can be quite long. When the weather doesn't permit it, they will stop the service. We experienced it on the way up. The winds were so strong, we were swaying left and right. The view on the way up was stunning. When we reached the peak, it was ice covered. It was really a great experience.

This is a great mountain scenic place, unfortunately during the summer when the weather is nice, the line waiting to get into the park was horrendous. The management of ticketing, lines and bus arrival were all top, nothing to complain about. It is just the sheer number of visitors coming here was a bit mind boggling. I arrived at 9:30, there were at least 5000 pp in front of me snaking from the top to the bottom and around halls of the main building. you need a lot of patience. In addition, most Chinese could buy their tickets from their phone, but you without residence card have to go there in person w your passport. the popular cable car tkts to the top or mid stations were already sold out in my case, no chance in summer. Try to ask someone who is willing to buy those tickets for you using their acct way in advance. otherwise you will be like me feeling disappointed not to be able to get a ticket upon arrival. Natural beauty 5*, tickets allocated to non ID holders, foreigners 3*.

Dragon Jade Mountain, or Yulong Snow Mountain, is a stunning, sacred mountain range in Lijiang, Yunnan, China, famous for its 13 snow-capped peaks, lush valleys, glaciers, and rich Naxi culture, offering stunning views accessible via cable car, with its highest peak, Shanzidou, reaching 5,596 meters. Thick and windproof clothing was essential in freezing cold mountains area. Bring some portable oxygen canisters and walk slowly up the trails staircase. There were public toilets available on the mountains. We visited the day where it was wet and misty weather, we still had a very unique experience under the rainfall. The opportunity to be up in the mountains surrounded by the fresh mist was a wonderful experience.💞🌬🏔🗻

Beautiful grandiose mountain view. GO early else there will be a long que up starting from the cable car. was there by 7am. much less people. only Lijiang authourized agent can get entrance ticket. not sure whether tourist can get tickets themselves. do check.. portable oxigen tank is advisable to bring. there will be some pressure on the breathing and heart. go slow, no rush. take time to pause and adjust breathing when going up the stairs. only buy oxigen tank from pharmacy , else might get bogus oxigen tank. got mine about 50RMB. enjoy the view......
Took my breath away at a 4,000m+ altitude, with thin oxygen on a sunny yet foggy 5C morning.

Absolutely amazing and a must visit place in Lijiang. However, it’s very commercialised and there are many influencers coming here to take pictures rather than just enjoying the amazing views. Didn’t manage to get a ticket to go to the 4680m as the tickets sell out in 1 min. Need to book on WeChat, 8pm the day before.

I recently visited Yulong Snow Mountain and was captivated by its breathtaking views. The majestic scenery painted a picturesque landscape that left me in awe. However, our experience was dampened as we arrived during a snowfall, restricting access to the higher end of the mountain. Despite the setback, the lower slopes still offered a mesmerizing experience, showcasing the beauty of the snow-covered peaks. The snowfall added a magical touch to the surroundings, creating a serene and tranquil atmosphere. While we couldn't explore the summit due to safety reasons, I appreciate the concern for visitors' well-being. It's essential to check weather conditions before planning a visit to make the most of this stunning destination. Overall, Yulong Snow Mountain is a must-visit for nature enthusiasts, but be mindful of the weather to ensure a more comprehensive exploration of this natural wonder.
We didn’t go up to the highest peak so didn’t see the glaciers and snow scene. Quite a bummer. We assumed Yulong mountain in the itinerary means the peak.
Awesome views of one of the most famous mountains in China. Breathtaking views while experiencing breathlessness. Worth the visit and climb. But altitude sickness is very real so do take precautions.

Fantastic experience. But expect long queues and big crowds. They have jackets for rent at 50RMB if yours is not sufficient. The morning we went up it was not too cold/bad as there was bright and strong sunshine. They also sell oxygen respirators by vending machine. This is very useful especially if you have symptoms of altitude sickness or dizzyness. It definitely helped me get over some wooziness i felt at the top. Beautiful and clean and well maintained. It was most enjoyable and worth the wait.
It’s a fake constructed park… it feels like you’re in Disney World and it’s full of people. If you like nature, don’t go there.

Be sure to breathe in plenty of oxygen so you get your blood saturated with oxygen hour ahead of time and before you even get close to the main entrance, or it would be a pity to not make it up to the 4680m viewpoint due to altitude sickness.
Absolutely amazing experience and view. A must visit destination. Although quite difficult to visit alone, you might want to come with a group tour early during sunrise.

Stunning scenery.. Definitely worth a vist... But please take some advise. Buy your oxygen bottles before going as there alot cheaper in the villages than from a tour guide or on the mountain. And please use them even if you think your OK.. I went with a party of 18 and every single one of us and some affects from altitude sickness. And in a couple cases they were being sick with very low oxygen levels... Fortunately there is a oxygen room on the top of the mountain near the cable cars. There is no climbing involved as it's a cable car all the way... So people of all ages can try it... It really is a once in a lifetime experience.. Definitely worth.. There's loads parking. And plenty of food shops along with restaurants and rest rooms... Plus places to store your goods for a small cost. A good day out.. But a bit of advice don't stay at the top for to long as the thin air will definitely affect.. There are, also tibetian shows in the afternoon. When we went it was not to cold at the top it was 3 degrees... But if the wind is blowing you definitely feel a bite in the wind so wrap up warm.... 🙏❤️🙏

Extremely cold.. below -7° C The oxygen level is low up there, so you need to bring 1 or 2 oxygen tanks... for asthma patients do not worry. Just bring more that 2 is enough, and make sure to keep taking the oxygen when you feel dizziness and take your inhaler pam before going up. Suit up the thermal or heatpack shirt and good winter jacket. The view from cable car is already magnificent ..up the glacier is more wonderful and magnificent ✨️ 😍

After our first visit 2 years ago, this year we learned how to reserve the cable cart in advance. The online book was fine even though it was a bit complicated! We visited the mountain top during off season, yet it was crowded. It took us 2 hours lining up in various queues (shuttle bus, cable cart, ticketing) for a one and half hour visit at the top. The hike to the top took about 45 minutes and it was tough due to lack of oxygen. A can of oxygen is a must provided no high attitude sickness!

The mountain view is great if the weather is good with little fog, personally I think the blue moon valley is prettier (see photos). Very crowded most of the time but crowd management is ok, be prepared to queue at the cable car and shuttle bus station.

This place is so beautiful but can get very crowded over time. Try to arrive early in the morning to avoid long queue. The turquoise color lake provides a scenic landscape for photography. Prepare your own oxygen can before going up there as you might experience high altitude sickness

So admiring! Yulong Xueshan or Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in Lijiang is the 71st highest mountain in the world. It has snow all year round and its highest peak named Shanzidou is 5,596 meters above sea level. Yulong Snow Mountain is called "Oulu" in Naxi language, meaning silvery mountain rock. The cableway station at Ganhaizi starts from an altitude of 3,356 meters up to the Glacier Park at an altitude of 4,506 meters, then take a short walk on the wooden plank road to the highest point of 4,680 meters above sea level.
expect lots of queues, worth the wait, you may or may not see the top, not sure they have the height markers correct

Yulong Snow Mountain is the southernmost glacier in the northern hemisphere. Its highest peak is named Shanzidou, 5,596 m (18,360 ft) above sea level. I would highly recommend to prepare your body before climb up to the mountain. I have seen most of the people get the altitude sickness very badly (including myself)

Beautiful place to visit. Because of the altitude, one who has possible altitude sickness should avoid taking the cable car going up to summit. Healthy one too is recommended to use mini oxygen tank. On a clear day, view from top is remarkable. Impression of Lijiang is a good show to watch as well. There is limited restaurant choices at the resort especially for Muslim visitors. End to end price arrangement from city, up to peak, meal and show can be expensive.

I love this place in China. This is my First time when I visited. I feel excited and my chinese group very friendly. It is my top favorite place when I travel around my country. I take a lot of photo here. I feel so cold when climb to the top of mountain. Remeber that day make me feel better. I want to travel to more place like this and I think I learn more experience that I never got. Thank you for the friend group for take care me and my gf. I miss them. ;)

Step 1. Drive up to, get a ride, or join your group to the visitor center. There are a few restaurants here but mainly it’s the place to get on the eco bus. Step 2. Wait in line to get on the eco bus. It will take you to the gondola. Step 3. Arrive at the gondola and get in line to ride up. It’s about a 10 min ride up to 4500 m. Step 4. Look around or take the boardwalk up to 4680 m. It rewarding to make it up that high in the thin air. Plus you can get your name engraved on a medal or eat a hot dog at the worlds highest elevation hot dog stand. Step 5. Go back down to gondola and do it all in reverse. Depending on your ticket you likely also have entrance to the 2 pm performance of Lijain Impressions. It’s a pretty impressive show with singing, dancing, horses, and hundreds of actors. Great music and English translations too. What to bring? Layers or jackets. It can be quite cold up here. The day we went it was in the 40’s but it was sunny on the last day of May. They also sell you oxygen canisters. Don’t know that they are necessary but we inhaled them on the steps up. Seemed to help but maybe just psychological. Because it was sunny, the view and experience was amazing. I can see coming up on a foggy or rainy day it can seem like a waste of time. If you have never been at elevation this is an easy way to go. Gondola up and you can go right back down and say you did it.
Beautiful view. It's a bit hard to walk up to get the best view, however it is worth it. Nice weather in June. I was wearing a t-shirt.
Stunning scenery. The natural park was well managed. Little walking was needed as there is shuttle bus service that connects the tourist spots. Expect lots of people.

A great giant mountain with amazing view. You might be shocked by all these breathtaking landscape. Careful, you might feel dizzy due to the high altitude. Take the cable car to get on the observation point. If you want to reach the highest spot, you need to take a walk to reach it.
If you're considering visiting, it's an absolute must. The views are incredible. I ended up proposing here.

Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is the closet to Equator 365 days snowed peak. The Yulong mountain is at 4506 meter above sea level.Must see.Visit also the Blue Moon Lagoon and the Impression Lijiang Show. Timing is 8:30 AM - 4:00 PM. The snowcapped Yulong Mountain is a sanctuary for rare animals and plants. We spent more than 2 hours on waiting. Experience of sitting in the cable car is exciting . They will provide oxygen bottle before riding. How to reach :- Take a cab to Hongtaiyang Square where there is a distinctive statue of Mao Zedong. In Lijiang, cab runs on meter, which is great for tourists. Fyi, within the city, cab fare is around 10rmb. At the square, look out for the parked mini vans across the road. These vans have sign boards indicating the destination. It only departs when full. Vans leave as early as 7 am, fare 20-25rmb, journey about 50 min to 1 hour, depending on traffic. Once there, you need to purchase the entrance ticket,'130 renbimbi' at the ticket office. If you intend to watch the Lijiang Impression Show, it is better to get the ticket first.
Amazing view of one of the world’s wonder.. Being at more than 4000m above sea level is an incredible experience.
Spectacular view from the top. Arrived at the top by cable car that elevates to 4,608 and need to walk a little to reach to the summit. Breathless attraction. A must when visiting Lijiang👍👍

The place you must go when visiting Lijiang. I have a great day hiking. Spectacular view from the top. It is at 4506 meter above sea level. The experience of sitting in the cable car is exciting . You should bring oxygen bottle before riding.
Beautiful scenery!! It was raining and misty when I went, no snow. Be wary of high altitude sickness.

A must visit wonder in Yunnan. Visit the place on 22nd Dec Fri with tour guide. The entrance itself at 8am was packed with crowds local & tourists alike. The ropeway to reach the top took about 5mins. This picturesque landscape is mesmerizing with instagram worthy photoshop so it’s hard to find a remote spot to admire the nature because of the crowd.

A must visit place that full of nature and culture in Yunnan! Some of you must be curious how many races people here work together even live together with their own lifestyle and habit! The most shocking view is Yulong Snow Mountain and their super natural own fondant and waterfall that fall down by snow from mountain. The water is really clear through their strict management that the river is not allow tourist to wash hand or even throw rubbish. The last, is Zhang Yi Mou's show that performed by local people that from different clan! (they're not actors, they're truly what clan they are!) This show made me truly touched which I'm Chinese people that far away from Malaysia. So that's why feeling touched for these of cultures and peoples still at there and perform to all the people from the world who can truly understand their culture!
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is a beautiful mountain range in Lijiang. Its highest peak, Shanzidou, is 5,596 metres above sea level. Need to take cable car to Spruce Meadow.

玉龙雪山 in direct translation, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is the pride of 云南 Yunnan towering 5,596 meters. Magnificently situated near 丽江 Lijiang, the river flowing from the snow capped mountain gives abundant life to the inhabitants, wildlife, flora and fauna. For foreign visitors, best to go with a tour since the ticketing is really complicated. High altitude sickness and quick changing weather are real. Enjoy the adventure. Best time to visit is during winter when the sky is clear.
Just ensure to choose s good tour group, mine charged me extra for less services
Bring oxygen portable type because there are staircase to reach to the top. Unless you are an active person. No snow
It's a beautiful place to visit. one of the waterfalls I thought it was really beautiful in pictures turned out to be a man-made one though.

If you want to go here you need to buy ticket in advance 1 week prior there are tickets for 4650meter the glacier park which is sold out if you go for example today , there is also tickets for 3200 meter high it’s yun shamping cable car which you will see trees only no glacier at all! and also other one which is more lower
Its very beautiful in winter, unfottunately i met snow storm can not go to peak of mountain.

Way too overcrowded, people who have never walked a step in their lives trying to make it to the top clogging the path in the process, people smoking all over even when the sign clearly says “No Smoking”.
Must visit this place to experience the mountain peak and scene. Beautiful scene.

I love this view.. and the entrance fee always affordable. You should come Jan-may only. Because on june , you will never see the snow. But the view is still superb. Alot of food and drink you can try too.
This is simply the most beautiful place in the world. 6/5 stars for sure. A must visit!
A must place to visit in Lijiang. You will see a magnificient view. I love it very much and i wish to come back here in future. I've been here in Dec 2016.

No snow in July, temperature around 15, jackets not required. Nothing spectacular and long queues going up/down. Avoid joining local tours and head there before noon to get ample of time to explore the area.
I really hate how pictures cannot capture the magnificence that our eyes can. Definitely make a trip.
Beautiful place. Oxygen is thin on the mountain, don’t forget oxygen can before you go. The temperature is freezing.

Breathtaking view of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. Absolutely a must visit site as evident by China 5stars toursite rating. The 4506m platform is accessible by cable cars which makes visits like this possible for thousands of people. The last platform level of 4680m is reached through trudging the stairs connected. This bring visitors to a closer view of the 5596m peak. The platform 4506m can be seen at 27.105366°N, 100.199525°E google satellite image.
Beautiful but so crowded. Try to arrive here earlier for fewer people and shorter queqe
A very beautiful part of the world with clean, fresh air. Hope it’s still here for generations to come.
A great day tour from Lijiang and worthwhile every single step you need to make to reach the viewing platform in 4,680 meters. Fantastic views await !

Scam scam scam... dont be fooled by the relatively cheap tickets... tour operators try to fleece you through over-priced... well, everything... we chose the package with the sunrise, and regretted the waste of time waking up at 5AM to catch a tour bus that spends 2 hours going around ferrying other customers until the bus is jammed packed. This is the reason why everyone both foreigners and locals alike hate tour operators in China. You can buy tickets only at the counter at the foot of the mountain but the operator basically ties up with tour operators and the chances of getting tixs without a tour guide is 0%.

What a beautiful place on the earth, breathtaking views. must visit place if you go to Lijing. Make sure go to entrance before 7am in the morning to buy the tickets if you are travelling holiday season in China, because they are selling only limited amount of tickets or you can go through the travel agents. Bring your own oxygen can before you go there, much cheaper to buy them in the city than in the mountain. Walk slowly in top the mountain.

great day trip! not only for the "snow mountain itself" but the national park itself is just AMAZING, with the blue moon river part a great place! dont miss it and just go to see some snow :| the river is amazing! very simple to take a shuttle share taxi to the park but watch out of being scammed by none official shuttles. half price for students or people with random none english ID cards haha.

The Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is often hidden behind clouds, enshrouded by fogs and mists, imparting its own mysterious character. It is a treasure trove of glaciers, canyons, waterfalls, meadows and lakes. Its beauty is enhanced when the ambience of the landscape is transformed by the different intensity of sunlight at different times of the day, making it surreal. 🇨🇳 ภูเขาหิมะมังกรหยก (Jade Dragon Snow Mountains) เป็นอีกนึงภูเขาสูงที่ตั้งตระหง่านที่มีจุดสูงสุดถึง5,500เมตร ซึ่งห่างจากประเทศไทยไม่ไกล เดินทางโดยเครื่องบินไม่ถึง3ชั่วโมงมาลงที่เมืองลี่เจียง ก็สามารถมาพิชิตภูเขาสูงเช่นเดียวกับภูเขาในทวีปยุโรปหรือฝั่งอเมริกาได้แล้ว 👍 โดยเราสามารถเดินทางโดยรถบัส/รถประจำทาง/รถทัวร์ท้องถิ่นหรือเรียกแท็กซี่(didi) มาจากตัวเมืองลี่เจียงก็สะดวก จากนั้นนั่งกระเช้าทะลุเมฆหมอกจากระดับความสูง 3,356 เมตรไปยังที่ระดับความสูง 4,506 เมตรเหนือระดับน้ำทะเล ในเวลาเพียงไม่กี่นาที (มีหูอื้อๆเล็กน้อย) เราก็สามารถสัมผัสความอลังการของวิวและอากาศหนาวเย็นสบายบนภูเขาสูงที่มีลักษณะคล้ายสันหลังของมังกร หากใครมีเวลามากพอและไม่มีอาการแพ้ความสูง สามารถค่อยๆเดินตามบันไดขึ้นไปชมวิวในแต่ละจุดได้อย่างสวยงาม จนถึงจุดสูงสุดที่ความสูงระดับ 4,860 เมตร โดยผมแนะนำให้ขึ้นทางนึงแล้วลงอีกทางนึง จะได้เก็บบรรยากาศและวิวมุมต่างๆได้อย่างจุใจ 🧐😍 ข้อควรระวัง! - เนื่องจากภูเขามังกรหยกมีความสูงจากระดับน้ำทะเลค่อนข้างมาก ความดันอากาศและอ๊อกซิเจนค่อนข้างต่ำ อาจเกิดอาการแพ้ที่ราบสูงหรือ AMS (Acute Mountain Sickness) ซึ่งสามารถเกิดขึ้นได้กับทุกคน ทุกเพศทุกวัย โดยเฉพาะผู้ที่มีโรคหัวใจ,โรคความดันโลหิตสูง หากมีอาการใดๆต้องรีบแจ้งเจ้าหน้าที่ทันที ทั้งนี้สามารถทานยาเพื่อป้องกันโรคแพ้ความสูง เช่น Acetazolamide (diamox) ก็สามารถพอจะช่วยป้องกันได้เช่นกัน และแนะนำให้เดินหรือเคลื่อนไหวร่างกายช้าๆ ไม่รีบร้อนเกินไปนะครับ ✌️ - อุณหภูมิในฤดูหนาว มีความหนาวเย็นมากๆประกอบกับความแรงของลม ยิ่งทำให้หนาวเย็นขึ้นไปอีก ควรเตรียมเสื้อผ้าที่มีความอบอุ่นให้เพียงพอ และพื้นทางเดินและบันไดต่างๆถูกปกคลุมไปด้วยหิมะ พื้นที่บางจุดมีความลื่นมากๆ ต้องเดินอย่างระมัดระวัง ควรสวมใส่รองเท้าที่มีความลื่นน้อย(รองเท้าTrail) หรือใส่แผ่นตะขาบกันลื่นก็ได้เช่นกันครับ ✌️ ขอให้ทุกท่านที่จะเดินทางไปเที่ยวภูเขาหิมะมังกรหยกแห่งนี้ ท่องเที่ยวอย่างปลอดภัยและมีความสุขทุกท่านนะครับ ☺️ (เมื่อ 18 มิ.ย.68)

Đây là ngọn núi thứ 71 trong những ngọn núi cao nhất thế giới.

Nous sommes allés à Yulong Mountain et c'était magnifique. Pour accéder a la montagne, il vous faudra payer un ticket à 100 Yuans (50 pour les étudiants). Nous sommes allés à la forêt (accessible en téléphérique, il faut un ticket), il y a un chemin qui permet de faire le tour d'un grand enclos avec des chèvres et cela permet de voir la montagne et surtout le paysage qui est magnifique. Nous sommes ensuite allés plus en contrebas pour voir le "Blue lake" c'est un lac entre plusieurs autres lacs et celui ci a la particularité d'être d'un bleu ciel prononcé. Cela est dû à des métaux lourds dans le lac ce qui fait qu'aucun poisson ne vive dedans. Néanmoins, il y a beaucoup de vie autour, il y a des magasins, vous pouvez acheter de la nourriture, des souvenirs, des vêtements, vous pouvez même faire des photos avec un Yak à côté du lac. La vue avec le lac bleu ciel et la montagne enneigée en fond est sublime. Pensez à prendre une bouteille d'oxygène à Lijiang (il y en a à environ 10 Yuans) car la montagne étant haute, l'oxygène s'y fait plus rare. Nous avons passé une très bonne journée, je recommande.

reviews.text: Để lên được núi tuyết Ngọc Long,bạn ohair mất 30 phút đi từ Lệ giang cổ trấn tới đây. Độ cao đỉnh núi tuyết là 5596m. Để lên đỉnh núi bạn phải mua vé bạn phải canh mua tùe ngày trước đó mà chỉ bán trong vòng 1 phút. ( may mắn) . Ở dây cũng có vé chợ đen mà mình không dám mua. Đàng chuyển qua phương án là đi cáp treo đến độ cao hơn 3000m. Ngắm núi tuyết từ xa cũng quá đẹp. Giá lên núi khoảng 350k vnd. Nói chung giá cả không chênh với Vn là mấy. Các cô bé mặc đồ truyền thống rất đẹp.

Không nên đi núi tuyết vào mùa hè, nhất là khi trời mưa. Nếu đi vào hôm mưa, mây mù bạn không nên đi cáp lớn lên đỉnh núi vì những lý do sau: - Ngồi trong cáp hơi nước và sương mù bám ngoài ô kính nên ngồi trong cabin không thấy cảnh bên ngoài. - Núi chỉ có ít băng sót lại nên giống như công trường xây dựng dở.

コロナ禍直前の2019年12月に登って来ました。 外国人の場合、ある程度の中国語が話せて、WeChatが使えるスマートフォンを持っていないと、登るのは難しいかもしれません。 私の場合は中国語が全く話せず、WeChatも使えなかったので一旦は登るのを諦めかけましたが、地元の旅行会社のお兄さんや中国人観光客の協力のおかげで中国人の団体ツアー紛れ込んでなんとか登ることができました。 天候に恵まれ真っ青な空をバックに雪をまとった玉龍雪山はまさに絶景の一言。 忘れがたい経験になりました。
標高4680mの展望台まで登りました。酸素が薄くて結構大変でしたがなかなか経験できる高さではありませんので感動もひとしおでした！人生で見た景色の中でもかなりの上位に位置する思い出深い絶景でした！
在雪山下有好幾個湖 顏色由淺綠色到深藍色 因為湖裏面都是雪山留下來的水 擁有大量的礦物質 所以根本沒有魚 湖清澈得可以看到 水下面的 沉木 而且還有農家菜 便宜又好吃沒有味精的
ロープウェーでいとも簡単に4500mに到達できるなんて最高！この高さは経験済みなのでまあ酸素は要らないかな？と思ったけど買っていって正解。到着駅から更に上を目指す時、酸素があった方が体が楽になりました。雪で閉鎖され最高点まで行けなかったのが残念。とは言え景色は充分素晴らしく達成感がありました。折角麗江まで訪れたなら絶対行くべきです。

玉龍雪山是去雲南必到景點，預算一天時間，如果是自由行的話，最好參加當地的一天團，這樣交通接送比較方便行程可以去多幾個點，因為每一個景點都是必看的不能錯過，這裏有個表演叫印象麗江，是張藝謀統籌的絕對不能錯過，背景是雪山，幾百人的表演非常之精彩，故事非常感人，通常導遊都又會在車上說給你知麗江玉龍雪山上的故事，他們將這古代的故事編織為這演出，這裏風景非常之優美震撼，你想像不到一個玉龍雪山好幾個景點，每個景點都有他特別之處，因為這裏是高於海拔的，大家都要留意一下自己的身體，最好在未上山之前買定他們的氧氣，因為上山之後十分之貴

위룽쉐산 (玉龍雪山) 옥룡 설산, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 중국 서부의 가장 남단에 위치한 고산으로 여강에서 30km 떨어져있는 해발 5,596m, 길이 35㎞, 너비 12㎞ 설산이다. 13개 봉우리로 이루어져 있으며 최고봉은 扇子陡(선자두)이다. 산에 쌓인 눈이 마치 한 마리의 은빛 용이 누워 있는 모습과 흡사하다 하여 옥룡 설산 이라고 부른단다 희말라야 산군이랍니다 최고봉인 선자두에는 오를 수 없단다 나시족이 신성 시 하기 때문 이라나........... 관광객에게 개방된 빙천 공원의 해발 고도는 4506m~4680m입니다 중국국가에서 지정한 관광지 등급이 옥룡 설산의 빙천 공원이 무려 최고의 등급인 AAAAA급 관광지 랍니다 AAAAA급의 남발이 아닐런지..... 고산병의 증세가 발생 하구 케이블 카에 내리시면 빙천 공원의 상점에서 에어 캔을 사실 수 있으시고 붉은색의 방한의도 대여 가능합니다 운삼평에서 전동 버스를 타고 내리시면 케이블 카 탑승구이고 케이블 카에서 내리시면 빙천 공원이랍니다 빙천공원서 산책로를 따라 더 오르실 수 있지만 오후 3시에는 하산을 해야하고 공원내 고산병 치료 센타가 있습니다 옥룔설산 가는 메인 케이트부터 운삼평의 야생화를 일부 담아 보았습니다
운삼평 케이블카를 타고 올라가 테크를 따라 수목이 우거진 숲속을 약15분 정도 올라가니 연록색의 싱그러움이 한눈에 들어오는 편평한 초원이 나오고 그 주변을 산책하며 설산을 감상할 수 있도록 둘레를 테크로 정비해 놓았어요. 숲속에는 말과 양들도 보이고... 올라갈때는 구름 설산을 가려고 있었으나 다행히도 완전하지는 않지만 모습을 드러내 주어 다행....

玉龙雪山，为云南省丽江市境内雪山群，东界丽（江）鸣（音）公路，西临虎跳峡涧、南起玉湖，北至大具下虎跳峡口，地处东经100°4′2″-100°16′30″、北纬27°3′2″～27°18′57″之间，在丽江北面约15千米处，全长75千米，是北半球最近赤道终年积雪的山脉，隔江西与中甸雪山、东与绵绵山相并列，北自三江口，向南延伸到北纬27°，如扇面向古城展开。全山的13座山峰由南向北纵向排列，主峰扇子陡最高处海拔5596米，终年积雪，雪线高度介于4800～5000米之间。发育有亚欧大陆距离赤道最近的温带海洋性冰川。 玉龙雪山在纳西语中被称为“欧鲁”，意为“天山”。其十三座雪峰连绵不绝，宛若一条“巨龙”腾越飞舞，故称为“玉龙”。又因其岩性主要为石灰岩与玄武岩，黑白分明，所以又称为“黑白雪山”。是纳西人的神山，传说纳西族保护神“三朵”的化身。 玉龙雪山拥有丰富的自然和人文资源。1984年，云南玉龙雪山省级自然保护区建立。2001年，玉龙雪山被评为4A级旅游景区。2007年5月，玉龙雪山被评为国家首批5A级旅游景区。

신을 만날 수 있다는 그 곳, 운남의 '옥룡설산'입니다. 대부분 이 장소는 단체 관광으로 가시길 추천드리며, 대부분 그렇게 할 것이라고 믿습니다. 여기까지 가는거나, 옥룡설산 '공원' 내부의 교통이 굉장히 복잡한 연유로, 일반적인 여행가들이 다니기에는 무리가 있습니다. 중국인들도 대부분 단체 관광을 참가하거나, 자차를 가져와서 그나마 다닐정도이니깐요. 그리고 정산까지 올라가게 될 경우, 무려 해발 4000m 를 뚫고 서있게 됩니다. 정산에서 1시간 이상 있으실 계획이 있거나, 끝까지 등반하실 의향이 있으시다면 조그마한 산소통이나 추가 덮바를 미리 대여해두시길 바랍니다. 대부분 단체 투어에서 지급하거나 미리 말을 해줍니다. 옥룡설산 정산을 제외하고도, 주변에 다양한 멋진 풍광들이 존재하지만, 실질적을로 옥룡설산 정산을 다녀오고 나서는... 비교할 수 없는 풍경에 실망하실수도 있습니다. 특히 '구채구'를 다녀오셨다면 ㅎㄷㄷ; 내부에서 하는 공연은 꼭! 보세요! 중국에서도 손에 꼽히는 최고의 공연입니다.
웅장한 산세와 자연의 아름다움을 느낄 수 있습니다. 리장 시내의 로컬 여행사에서 하루 코스 상품을 CNY 500~800 사이 가격에 판매합니다. 공연 포함여부에 따라 가격은 좀 달라질 수 있습니다. 리장을 여행하신다면 1순위 방문지이니 꼭 가보세요. 낮은 구름이 낀 날이면 산 위 날씨는 좋을 수있으니, 흐린 날의 경우에도 성공 가능성 있습니다.

天候が良かったのでガイドの判断で急遽 玉龍雪山観光に予定を変更して 麗江のホテル(麗江官房大酒店)から 玉龍雪山のロープウェイ乗り場に向かいました｡ 車が郊外を抜けますと車窓から 雪を被った玉龍雪山の山並みが迫って来ます｡ ロープウェイ麓駅から頂駅迄は 約30分程乗ったと記憶しております ゴンドラは4人乗りと小さかったですが 景色は良かったです｡ 頂駅は標高約4500mです｡ ロープウェイを降りると 目の前は雪原が広がり頂上までが真っ白で 雄大な景色に感動し堪能しました。天気も良く真っ白な頂に ブルーの空が 映えとても綺麗でした｡ 街中から僅か3時間半程で標高4500mの雪の中に立っておられるとは思いませんでした｡ 標高が高い為高山病にかかりやすく 酸素ボンベが必需品です(ガイドが用意してくれました)｡ 帰りは玉峰寺に寄り 樹齢500年と云われる椿の木を見てきました｡ 木の幹の太さは有りませんが根元より数多くの枝が横に 上に張り巡る状態で年期を感じました｡
2019年の正月1日に玉龍雪山にいました。気温こそ低かったけど、最高の風景が見られてよかったです。人民が多く、迷子になりそうでしたが、天気よくて、なんともいえない、この冬 最高の思い出です。
私が行ったのはだいぶ前なので順番待ちはほとんどありませんでした。酸素ボンベは使わなかったけどロープウェイを降りてからの歩きは少し苦しかったです。しかしそこには まさに別世界の景色が広がっています。

중국 서부의 가장 남단에 위치한 고산으로 해발 5,596m, 길이 35㎞, 너비 12㎞이다. 13개 봉우리로 이루어져 있으며 최고봉은 산쯔더우[扇子陡(선자두)]이다. 산에 쌓인 눈이 마치 한 마리의 은빛 용이 누워 있는 모습과 비슷하다 하여 ‘옥룡설산’이라는 이름이 붙었다. 양쯔강의 상류인 진사장강[金沙江]을 사이에 두고 위룽쉐산과 하바쉐산[哈巴雪山(합파설산):5,396m]이 솟아 있고, 두 산 사이로 강을 따라 ‘호랑이가 건너뛸 만큼 좁다’라는 뜻의 후탸오샤[虎跳峡] 협곡지역이 길이 16㎞까지 이어진다. 위룽쉐산은 <서유기西遊記>에서 손오공이 갇혀 벌을 받았다는 산으로 전해진다. 해발 3,000ｍ 지점까지 등산로가 나 있고 4,500ｍ까지는 케이블카가 연결되어 있으며 케이블카에서 전망대까지는 원시림 사이로 산책로가 있다. 해발 4,450ｍ 지점에 윈사핑[雲杉坪(운삼평)]이 있는데, 삼나무 원시림으로 둘러싸인 넓은 평야이다. 위룽쉐산은 1년 내내 눈이 녹지 않는 만년설로 덮여 있고 희귀한 식물이 많아 중국의 빙하박물관 또는 식물왕국이라 불린다. 부근에 위룽쉐산의 만년설에서 흘러내린 물이 호수를 이룬 관광명소 헤이룽탄[黑龍潭(흑룡담)]공원이 있다.

Yulong Naxi Autonomous County (玉龙纳西族自治县) is located in **Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, China**, with the postal code **674112**. ### **Key Information:** - **Location:** Northwest Yunnan, part of the Greater Lijiang area. - **Ethnic Groups:** Primarily Naxi (纳西族), with Han, Yi, Tibetan, and Bai minorities. - **Attractions:** - **Jade Dragon Snow Mountain (玉龙雪山)** – A famous scenic and skiing destination. - **Tiger Leaping Gorge (虎跳峡)** – One of the deepest gorges in the world. - **Lijiang Ancient Town (丽江古城)** (nearby) – A UNESCO World Heritage Site. - **Culture:** Rich Naxi Dongba culture, known for its ancient pictographic script.
